decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update: workers at our ground handling contractor in Orlando and Philadelphia plan a 48-hour strike on Dec 22-23, so some flights may be late or canceled. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on Kestrel or on a partner airline, usually the same day, or refund you in full if you prefer.
decisions.why:
Our own seats are nearly full in week 8, so a canceled passenger needs another airline's seat to fly within 24 hours.
Goal 2 asks for 90% rebooked or refunded within a day.
It costs $0.25M.
